description: This file defines classes and functions for handling keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen input in a browser automation context, including key descriptions, modifier handling, and input simulation.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: Handles keyboard input simulation, including key presses, releases, text insertion, and modifier management.

classes.name: Mouse
classes.description: Simulates mouse actions such as move, click, down, up, and wheel.

methods.name: _keyDescriptionForString
methods.description: Resolves a string to a key description, considering modifiers.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types a string, handling individual character input.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing and releasing a key combination.

methods.name: ensureModifiers
methods.description: Ensures specified modifiers are pressed or released.

methods.name: _modifiers
methods.description: Returns the current set of pressed modifiers.
